names.en: All living beings luck true inheritance
aliases: All living being's luck true inheritance Giant Sun's all living beings luck true inheritance

summary.text: All living beings luck true inheritance is one of Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's three luck path true inheritances. Lang Ya land spirit says it was inside Imperial Court blessed land.

claims.text: Connect Luck, Break Luck, and Divert Disaster Immortal Gu belong to that all living being’s luck true inheritance. After Imperial Court blessed land was destroyed, some of those Immortal Gu went outside while the cultivation details were already lost.

Heaven Extremity says self luck replenishes oneself, all living being’s luck takes others’ surpluses to replenish oneself, and heaven and earth luck takes heaven and earth’s surpluses to replenish oneself. Five Elements Grandmaster had heard that Giant Sun created self luck, stalled, then gained inspiration from The Legends of Ren Zu to create all living being’s luck before ascending as Immortal Venerable and later creating heaven and earth luck.

Self luck sits in Lang Ya blessed land, all living being’s luck in Eighty-Eight True Yang Building, and heaven and earth luck in Longevity Heaven. When Imperial Court blessed land was destroyed and Eighty-Eight True Yang Building collapsed, the all living being’s luck true inheritance was destroyed as well, but Ma Hong Yun and Zhao Lian Yun had each received a portion while under its protection. Fang Yuan excavates Ma Hong Yun’s portion by soul search; in that portion the greatest value is the recipe of Fortune Rivalling Heaven Immortal Gu, named as the core essence of the all living being’s luck true inheritance. Because Ma Hong Yun learned of that true inheritance, Shadow Sect also knows of it through Qin Bai Sheng’s capture of him.

Fang Yuan finds the immortal killer move fixed luck in Ma Hong Yun’s soul and treats it as part of all living beings luck from Giant Sun’s true inheritance. Its effect is to make one’s luck unwavering and not easily influenced, which he wants against the downside of Connect Luck. From the content of all living beings luck he also knows that close relationships join luck, and that allies on the same side unify luck so they rise or fall together.
Among his luck path true inheritances, the most prominent are Giant Sun’s self luck and all living beings luck; he has the complete content of the former and an incomplete version of the latter.

With the complete self luck true inheritance and a portion of all living beings luck true inheritance, Fang Yuan only needs to look at luck’s colors and shapes to learn conditions and deduce much information.

Qin Ding Ling says that soul searching Zhao Lian Yun for information on Giant Sun’s all living beings luck true inheritance let her find Giant Sun’s arrangements that her own attainment alone would have missed. She names Giant Sun’s trio of self luck, all living beings luck, and heaven and earth luck, and notes that Zhao Lian Yun saw the all living beings luck true inheritance in Imperial Court blessed land but obtained only a tiny portion.

Fang Yuan judges that Cooking Luck Pot is weak in offense and strong in defending luck, and that luck path offensive methods are mostly in the true inheritances of all living beings luck and heaven and earth luck.

Holders.text: Fang Yuan Ma Hong Yun Zhao Lian Yun

Location.text: Imperial Court blessed land; Eighty-Eight True Yang Building
